findings.claim: Structural apply admits successful mutation on a Linux installation whose fixed ln executable is uutils rather than GNU, while support wording names a GNU matrix.
proof_refs: publishAuthenticated gates Linux and the capability probe proves behavior but does not authenticate architecture or tool branding.
/usr/bin/ln --version reports uutils coreutils 0.8.0 while focused structural apply succeeds.

findings.claim: Cumulative git diff --check reports Markdown hard-break whitespace although the report records the clean-worktree command as passing.
proof_refs: git diff --check main...HEAD reports trailing whitespace in Markdown hard-break lines.

evidence: Verified immutable HEAD, tree, cumulative diff hash, and clean status before and after review.
Inspected all 20 scoped paths, issue #127, OpenSpec artifacts, implementation, tests, support docs, and Harness guard evidence.
Focused acceptance, publication, structural apply, and Harness denial tests passed.

findings.claim: Receipt recovery and idempotent replay compare postimage bytes but do not compare the prepared mode, so a finite chmod between receipt failure and retry can be accepted as exact recovery.
proof_refs: The in-memory applied and imported-record recovery branches compare updatedHash only while the persisted plan retains file.mode.
The receipt recovery test asserts bytes but does not mutate mode.

evidence: Verified immutable HEAD, tree, cumulative diff hash, and clean status before and after review.

suspect.claim: Receipt recovery does not revalidate prepared file mode.

rationale: The two blind judges confirmed no common severe finding and produced no contradiction. Under Judgment Day policy, single-judge severe reports remain suspects and warnings remain informational; no correction actor may be launched.
